user.title: WoowTech Cover Entity
user.description: Configure your cover entity using entity selectors and optional action scripts.

data_description.name: A friendly name for this cover entity.
data_description.device_class: The type of cover (blind, shade, curtain, etc.).
data_description.position_entity: Entity to sync cover position with (input_number, number). Enables TX/RX.
data_description.tilt_position_entity: Entity to sync tilt position with (input_number, number). Enables TX/RX.
data_description.open_time: Time in seconds for the cover to fully open (0% to 100%). Enables time-based position estimation.
data_description.close_time: Time in seconds for the cover to fully close (100% to 0%). Enables time-based position estimation.
data_description.tilt_open_time: Time in seconds for the tilt to fully open. Requires Enable Tilt.
data_description.tilt_close_time: Time in seconds for the tilt to fully close. Requires Enable Tilt.
data_description.set_position: Optional: Action script override for position changes. Variable: {{ position }}
data_description.set_tilt_position: Optional: Action script override for tilt position changes. Variable: {{ tilt_position }}
data_description.open_cover: Optional: Action script for opening the cover.
data_description.close_cover: Optional: Action script for closing the cover.
data_description.stop_cover: Optional: Action script for stopping the cover.
data_description.open_tilt: Optional: Action script for opening the tilt.
data_description.close_tilt: Optional: Action script for closing the tilt.
data_description.stop_tilt: Optional: Action script for stopping tilt movement.

error.time_pair_incomplete: Both Opening Time and Closing Time must be configured together for time-based position estimation.
error.tilt_time_pair_incomplete: Both Tilt Opening Time and Tilt Closing Time must be configured together.
